areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Integrates environmental and climate-resilience concerns into road management, with drainage, slope protection and remediation of environmental liabilities.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Performance-based, long-term contracting model improves road service delivery and spending efficiency.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Studies on energy transition are foreseen, but no actions directly on energy efficiency or renewables.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Drainage restoration is covered, but no actions directly on basic sanitation.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Erosion and water-body damage reduction relates to climate resilience, not water security.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Environmental awareness and good practices are covered, but no actions directly on biodiversity or forests.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Infrastructure improvement for competitiveness, but no actions directly on the business environment.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Infrastructure improvement for competitiveness, but no actions directly benefiting small firms.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Jobs arise from the works, but no actions directly on employment and income.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Transport infrastructure in a lower-income region, but no actions directly aimed at vulnerable populations.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Sustainable-tourism actions in traditional or indigenous areas, but alignment with the agency's legal remit and sector plan was not clarified.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Jobs from the works target a specific population, but no actions directly on youth, gender or race policies.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Road-safety actions are covered, but none directly associated with education or health.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Institutional strengthening of infrastructure management, but no actions directly on technology or innovation.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Support to concession-policy reform and benchmarking, but no financing arrangements directly contributing to private participation.
